            matches. The values of the index at the matching locations must
            satisfy the equation ``abs(index[indexer] - target) <= tolerance``.

cd /testbed && cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/patch.py
import re, pathlib

pat_id = re.compile(r"\.(sel|isel)\(\*\*([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)\)")
pat_dict = re.compile(r"\.(sel|isel)\(\*\*(\{[^}]*\})\)")

files = sorted(pathlib.Path("xarray/core").glob("*.py")) + sorted(pathlib.Path("xarray/plot").glob("*.py"))
for p in files:
    orig = p.read_text()
    new = pat_id.sub(r".\1(\2)", orig)
    new = pat_dict.sub(r".\1(\2)", new)
    if p.name == "dataset.py":
        new = new.replace("self.isel(**cast(Mapping, key))", "self.isel(cast(Mapping, key))")
    if new != orig:
        p.write_text(new)
        print("patched", p)
